label.purpose: Uppercase section headings on the dark ground (rail title; footer at 15px).

body.purpose: Header fields and reading text (15px under 640px).

ui.purpose: Tabs, buttons, stamp names, viewer titles.

shadows.name: pressed-in-segment

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action per view: choose a file, download.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8l-6-6m4 18H6V4h7v5h5v11m-6-9-4 4h3v4h2v-4h3l-4-4Z"/></svg>Choose a file</button>

components.name: Paper Button
components.description: White button on the dark ground, e.g. Open another file.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Message / Headers switch on the letter sheet.
components.css: .ds-sheet{background:#fff;padding:8px 24px 24px;border-radius:3px}.ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-book-200,#cfd7d4)}.ds-tabs button{padding:10px 16px;border:0;background:none;font:600 15px var(--font-sans,Barlow,sans-serif);color:var(--color-book-500,#4f5f5b);cursor:pointer;transition:color 150ms ease-out,box-shadow 150ms ease-out}.ds-tabs button:hover{color:var(--color-book-800,#16201e)}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--color-book-800,#16201e);box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--color-ultramarine,#23408e)}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-ultramarine,#23408e);outline-offset:-2px}

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Formatted / Plain text choice on paper.
components.css: .ds-seg{display:inline-flex;padding:2px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--color-book-100,#e7ecea)}.ds-seg button{padding:6px 12px;border:0;border-radius:3px;background:none;font:600 14px var(--font-sans,Barlow,sans-serif);color:var(--color-book-500,#4f5f5b);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out}.ds-seg button:hover{color:var(--color-book-800,#16201e)}.ds-seg button[aria-checked=true]{background:#fff;color:var(--color-book-800,#16201e);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 21 / .18)}.ds-seg button:focus-visible{outline: 2px solid var(--color-ultramarine-light); outline-offset: 2px;}

components.name: Language Switch
components.description: EN / FR switch in the top bar.
components.css: .ds-ground{background:var(--color-book-800,#16201e);padding:16px}.ds-locale{display:inline-flex;padding:2px;border:1px solid var(--color-book-600,#34433f);border-radius:4px}.ds-locale a{padding:4px 8px;border-radius:3px;font:600 13px var(--font-sans,Barlow,sans-serif);letter-spacing:.025em;color:var(--color-book-300,#a3afac);text-decoration:none;transition:color 150ms ease-out,background-color 150ms ease-out}.ds-locale a:hover{color:var(--color-book-100,#e7ecea)}.ds-locale a.current{background:var(--color-book-600,#34433f);color:#fff}.ds-locale a:focus-visible{outline: 2px solid var(--color-ultramarine-light); outline-offset: 2px;}

components.name: Stamp
components.description: Signature: an attachment as a perforated stamp, one ink per kind, size as denomination.
components.css: .ds-strip{list-style:none;margin:0;display:grid;gap:16px;padding:16px 14px;width:300px;background-color:var(--color-book-800,#16201e);background-image:linear-gradient(rgb(214 226 232 / .12),rgb(214 226 232 / .07));border-top:1px solid rgb(233 238 240 / .3)}.ds-stamp{--perf:6px;display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:var(--perf);background:radial-gradient(circle at var(--perf) var(--perf),transparent 3px,#fff 3.5px) calc(var(--perf) * -1) calc(var(--perf) * -1)/calc(var(--perf) * 2) calc(var(--perf) * 2) round;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / .3));transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),filter 180ms ease-out}.ds-stamp:hover{transform:translateY(-2px) rotate(-.6deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / .4))}.ds-stamp:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-ultramarine-light,#8fa6e6);outline-offset:4px}.ds-stamp:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;--ink:var(--color-book-400,#74827e);filter:grayscale(1) drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .25));opacity:.7;transform:none}.ds-stamp:disabled .ds-name{text-decoration:line-through}.ds-face{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:baseline;column-gap:12px;row-gap:4px;background:#fff;padding:10px 12px 12px}.ds-ink{grid-column:span 2;height:6px;margin-bottom:6px;background:var(--ink)}.ds-name{font:600 15px/1.375 var(--font-sans,Barlow,sans-serif);color:var(--color-book-800,#16201e);overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-value{grid-row:span 2;align-self:start;white-space:nowrap;font:700 22px/1 var(--font-display,'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink)}.ds-meta{font:400 13px var(--font-sans,Barlow,sans-serif);color:var(--color-book-500,#4f5f5b)}.ds-stamp-pdf{--ink:var(--color-carmine,#c0283a)}.ds-stamp-image{--ink:var(--color-ultramarine,#23408e)}.ds-stamp-other{--ink:var(--color-olive,#5b6a2b)}

components.name: Postmark
components.description: Signature: the only circle, struck onto the letter with the local-only promise and open time.
components.css: .ds-sheet{background:#fff;padding:32px;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgb(0 0 0 / .35);isolation:isolate}.ds-postmark{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:132px;height:132px;margin-left:auto;border:3px solid currentColor;border-radius:9999px;text-align:center;color:var(--color-ultramarine,#23408e);transform:rotate(-8deg);animation:ds-cancel 420ms 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) backwards}.ds-postmark::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:-64px;right:-12px;top:50%;height:36px;transform:translateY(-50%);border-top:3px solid currentColor;border-bottom:3px solid currentColor;opacity:.18;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none}.ds-postmark small{font:600 11px var(--font-display,'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-postmark strong{margin:2px 0;max-width:90%;font:700 22px/1.05 var(--font-display,'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif);text-transform:uppercase}@keyframes ds-cancel{from{transform:rotate(-14deg) scale(1.25);opacity:0}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.ds-postmark{animation-duration:.01ms}}

components.name: Remote Content Notice
components.description: Reports that remote images are blocked, with a toggle; a protection, not a warning.
components.html: Remote images are blocked, so the sender can't tell you opened this email.
components.css: .ds-sheet{background:#fff;padding:24px;border-radius:3px}.ds-notice{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 12px;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--color-book-100,#e7ecea);color:var(--color-book-700,#212c29);font:400 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans,Barlow,sans-serif)}.ds-notice svg{flex-shrink:0;color:var(--color-book-500,#4f5f5b)}.ds-notice p{margin:0;flex:1 1 15rem;min-width:0}.ds-notice button{padding:6px 12px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;color:var(--color-ultramarine,#23408e);font:600 14px var(--font-sans,Barlow,sans-serif);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 21 / .18);cursor:pointer}.ds-notice button:hover{background:var(--color-book-200,#cfd7d4)}.ds-notice button:focus-visible{outline: 2px solid var(--color-ultramarine-light); outline-offset: 2px;}

components.name: Drop Hint
components.description: Dashed empty slot on the ground inviting another file.

narrative.overview:
The page is a collector's stockbook opened on a dark green-grey leaf. The email is a white letter laid on top of a small stack of sheets; its attachments are mounted in a glassine strip beside it as perforated stamps, each printed in one engraved ink for its kind and carrying its file size as the denomination. A single circular postmark, struck at an angle onto the letter, carries the local-only promise and the moment the file was opened. Everything else is flat, quiet, and squared to the page.

Density is calm and operational: one letter, one rail, generous margins, nothing competing with the message. The palette is one neutral ramp plus three inks, and the inks are rationed: ultramarine marks what is active, carmine marks PDFs and warnings, olive marks every other file. Physical objects (sheets, stamps, postmark) are the only things allowed to tilt or cast shadow; the page structure around them stays strictly orthogonal.

The world rejects the mail-client split pane and the white SaaS card holding a file input.
keyCharacteristics: Dark stockbook ground built from a single 9-step green-grey ramp; no other neutrals.
White paper sheets stacked with slight rotation; one more sheet when attachments exist.
Three engraved inks, each with a fixed meaning, and light variants reserved for the dark ground.
Perforated stamps with one ink per attachment kind and size as the denomination.
One circular postmark per view, and it is the only circle.
Barlow for reading, Barlow Semi Condensed for subjects, denominations, postmark, and labels.

rules.name: The Single Ramp Rule
rules.body: The nine book steps plus paper white are the only neutrals. No Tailwind greys, no ad-hoc hex greys; tints are built by mixing a book step with transparency.

rules.name: The Ink Has A Meaning Rule
rules.body: Ultramarine is active, carmine is PDF or warning, olive is every other file. An ink never appears as decoration without that meaning.

rules.name: The Ground Variant Rule
rules.body: Base inks carry text and icons on paper; their light or bright variants carry text and icons on the dark ground. Base inks may appear on the ground only as non-text bars (the modal's ink edge).

rules.name: The Struck Type Rule
rules.body: Semi Condensed is for what would be printed or stamped: subjects, display titles, denominations, the postmark, labels, the wordmark. Reading text, controls, and field values are always Barlow.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Sizes, counts, and times use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Only Paper Casts Rule
rules.body: Sheets, stamps, and previewed pages cast shadows; bars, rails, notices, and buttons on the ground do not.

rules.name: The Paper Stack Rule
rules.body: The letter always sits on one backing sheet (book-200, rotated about -1.5°, offset -6px/6px); when the email has attachments a second sheet appears beneath it (book-300, rotated 1.2°, offset 8px/4px).

rules.name: The One Circle Rule
rules.body: The postmark is the only circle in the system, and there is at most one per view. Perforation holes are part of the stamp edge, not shapes of their own.

rules.name: The Square Page Rule
rules.body: Structural rules (hairlines, borders, dividers, tab underlines, dashed slots) run only at 0° and 90°. Rotation belongs to physical objects: backing sheets, the postmark with its cancellation bars, the stamp's hover tilt, and the lay-down motion.

rules.name: The Dashed Means Empty Rule
rules.body: A dashed outline (1.5px book-600 on the ground, 2px ultramarine-light while dragging) marks a slot waiting for something: ghost stamps, the drop-another-file hint, the drag target.

dos: **Do** take every neutral from the nine book steps or paper white; build tints by giving a book step transparency.
**Do** give each attachment kind its fixed ink (PDF carmine, image ultramarine, other olive) on the stamp bar, denomination, and the viewer's top edge.
**Do** use the light or bright ink variant for text and icons on the dark ground, and the base ink on paper.
**Do** set subjects, display titles, denominations, labels, and the postmark in Barlow Semi Condensed; everything readable in Barlow.
**Do** keep the postmark as the single circle per view, struck at -8° with a 3px ring.
**Do** keep hairlines, borders, and underlines at 0° or 90°; let only sheets, stamps, and the postmark rotate.
**Do** use exponential ease-out for anything that lands, and honour reduced motion by removing it.
**Do** mark empty slots with a dashed book-600 outline.
donts: **Don't** introduce a neutral outside the book ramp, or use Tailwind's default greys.
**Don't** use an ink without its meaning: no carmine accents that are not PDFs or warnings, no olive outside non-PDF, non-image files and the local/safe signal.
**Don't** add a second circle: no round avatars, pill badges, circular icon buttons, or a second postmark.
**Don't** draw rules at diagonals or put shadows on chrome; depth belongs to paper.
**Don't** give stamps rounded corners or a plain border; their edge is perforated.
**Don't** put base ultramarine, carmine, or olive text on the dark ground.
**Don't** stack an uppercase label above a heading; labels are headings of their own section.
